C&T TECHNOLOGIES received a task order from HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF.

It is valued at up to $211,602,477.36.

The obligated amount is $38,648,020.90.

NAICS 541512 (COMPUTER SYSTEMS DESIGN SERVICES). PIID 75FCMC27F0004. Parent award PIID HHSM500201700012I.

Set-aside: SMALL BUSINESS SET ASIDE - TOTAL.

Competition: FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION.

The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services awarded a task order to C&T Technologies on November 14, 2026, for computer systems design services. The task order, which is set aside for small businesses, has an obligation of approximately $38.6 million against a ceiling of $211.6 million and runs through November 14, 2027. The award was made through full and open competition. The work involves information technology and telecommunications support for business application development. The specific scope of work is detailed in the statement of objectives and related exhibits for this task order.

A contract for AKUMEN, INC. from STATE, DEPARTMENT OF was recently released.

It was signed on October 30, 2026.

The public record is dated November 16, 2026.

It is valued at up to $53,550,046.40.

The obligated amount is $5 million.

NAICS 541519 (OTHER COMPUTER RELATED SERVICES). PIID 19AQMM27C0072.

Competition: NOT COMPETED.

The Department of State awarded a definitive contract to AKUMEN, INC. for information technology management support services. The contract, signed on October 30, 2026, and released publicly on November 16, 2026, carries an initial obligation of $5 million against a ceiling of approximately $53.6 million. The work runs from November 1, 2026, through April 30, 2027. The contract was awarded without competition. AKUMEN will provide technology application services in support of the Department's diplomatic operations. The work falls under the computer-related services industry classification.

A contract for SCIENCE APPLICATIONS INTERNATIONAL CORPORATION from Department of the Treasury was recently released.

It was signed on September 30, 2026.

The public record is dated November 17, 2026.

The obligated amount is $44,611,416.35.

NAICS 541512 (COMPUTER SYSTEMS DESIGN SERVICES). PIID 2099AC26F00075. Parent award PIID 2032H523A00010.

Competition: FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION.

The Treasury Common Services Center awarded Science Applications International Corporation a blanket purchase agreement call valued at approximately $44.6 million. The award, signed on September 30, 2026, and released publicly in November 2026, supports computer systems design services for the Internal Revenue Service under an existing single-award agreement. The work runs through September 29, 2027. This award represents an option period exercise under the existing blanket purchase agreement and was competed through a full and open competition process. The effort focuses on information technology and telecommunications compute support services provided on a labor basis.
